description: Creates a link (url) that lets whoever manages the DNS (an agency, the IT team) connect the given domains with the given records, without the application secret. The link is bound to those domains and records, single-use per domain by default (maxUses) and expires in 7 days by default (expiresInDays, at most 30). Returns the url, which carries a token returned only in this answer, and the share_link_id. Connections started from the link are listed like any other, with that share_link_id.

dnsRecords.description: Records your product needs. host is relative to the zone; placeholders {DOMAIN}, {SUBDOMAIN}, {SLD}, {TLD}; @ is the apex (no CNAME at the apex).

domains.description: The domains the link may connect.

label.description: Your own note, never shown on the link page.

maxUses.description: Connections each domain may start through the link.

userId.description: Your own user id, echoed in the job and its webhooks.

name: create_share_link
title: Create a shareable connection link
